title: Kitten holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 44 Q58 56 54 66' stroke='#e8e8f0' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='30' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff5f6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='25' rx='4' ry='5.5' fill='#ff9aa2'/>
  <path d='M63 45 l-3 4 h6 z' fill='#c73e4c'/>
  <!-- kitten tail -->
  <path d='M30 76 Q18 74 18 64 Q18 58 24 58' stroke='#f4a259' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- kitten body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='74' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#f9b056'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='77' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#ffe0b0'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='86' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f9b056'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='86' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f9b056'/>
  <!-- raised arm holding string -->
  <path d='M52 68 Q56 60 55 56' stroke='#f9b056' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='55' r='4' fill='#f9b056'/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='63' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f9b056'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='48' r='16' fill='#f9b056'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M28 38 l-3 -10 l11 5 z' fill='#f9b056'/>
  <path d='M52 38 l3 -10 l-11 5 z' fill='#f9b056'/>
  <path d='M29 36 l-2 -6 l6 3 z' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
  <path d='M51 36 l2 -6 l-6 3 z' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='55' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#ffe0b0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='47' rx='2.6' ry='3.4' fill='#4a2c2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='47' rx='2.6' ry='3.4' fill='#4a2c2a'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='46' r='1' fill='#ffe9c9'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='46' r='1' fill='#ffe9c9'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M40 52 l-2 2 h4 z' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M40 54 q-2.5 3 -5 1' stroke='#a05a3a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 54 q2.5 3 5 1' stroke='#a05a3a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M30 53 l-8 -2 M30 56 l-8 1' stroke='#e8d0b0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 53 l8 -2 M50 56 l8 1' stroke='#e8d0b0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
